subject: Decision Making
title: Affirmative Action Debates
description: A short lesson to help you apply Affirmative Action Debates.

hook.text: Should universities give advantages to historically disadvantaged groups?

buildup.text: Supporters say affirmative action corrects systemic disadvantage. Critics say it violates individual merit and fairness.

discovery.text: Affirmative Action Debates reveals the key principle behind better choices under uncertainty.

twist.text: Studies show diverse campuses improve learning for all students. The benefit extends beyond the individuals admitted.

climax.text: Affirmative action is a clash between two valid conceptions of fairness. The dilemma has no clean resolution.

punchline.text: Affirmative Action Debates: good judgment beats certainty every time.

quiz.question: Why is affirmative action ethically complex?
options: Two valid conceptions of fairness — equal treatment now vs. correcting past inequality — conflict
Only one side has an argument
